whole_diet.accounting_rule: produced = consumed + seed/propagation + stored/reserved + livestock feed + exports + losses; annual crops fill residual household energy after retained perennial harvest.
whole_diet.annual_energy_share_basis: Shares are derived from crop family/layer roles unless the caller supplies explicit shares.

perennial_succession.accounting_note: Support plants occupy shared nominal space; they are ecological overlays and are not added as extra hectares. Canopy/root competition bounds additive layer output.
